core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Firdaus corresponds to the Arabic form فردوس (Arabic root ف ر د س (f-r-d-s), a borrowing from Middle Persian). Its core sense is paradise, garden. Firdaus (فردوس) means 'paradise, the highest garden'. The word is Arabic in form (used in the Qur'an for the highest level of paradise) but is itself borrowed from Middle Persian / Aramaic, which is why it sits at the meeting point of Arabic and Persianate vocabulary. It is used for both sexes in South Asia. It is a Qur'anic word rather than a personal name attested in the Qur'an.
